name: Armor Swap
author: glawks
description: Experimental native RAC2 armour vendor at Oozla; cosmetic only, no purchases.

settings.name: Visible armour
settings.description: Default cosmetic appearance on a save with no in-game preference. All visual armour tiers can be chosen even before buying them.

settings.name: Vendor interaction radius
settings.description: Triangle opens the vendor only within this radius around the bars at Oozla X297, Y418, Z115.

settings.name: Show Oozla test coordinates
settings.description: Optional developer overlay showing Ratchet's X/Y/Z position and distance to the Oozla vendor.
